description.text: Clinical medicine is a discipline that studies the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of diseases, aiming to cultivate practicing physicians with solid medical basic theories, clinical skills and professional qualities. The major takes the human body system as its core, integrates basic medicine with clinical practice, and focuses on cultivating students' comprehensive judgment ability of diseases, clinical operation ability and doctor-patient communication ability, ultimately enabling them to independently undertake clinical diagnosis and treatment work.

duration.text: The MBBS at Shantou University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3194 USD/per year ￥ 23000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Scanned copy of personal information in passporProof of high school education (or above) Scanned copies of academic transcripts for each academic year during high school (or above).Proof of Chinese proficiency

requirements.text: High school graduation or above; Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens. Obey laws and regulations, be diligent and eager to learn, have excellent academic performance, good conduct, be willing to abide by Chinese laws and regulations as well as the school rules and regulations of Shantou University, be friendly to China, and be physically and mentally healthy. For students applying for programs taught in Chinese, except for the major of Teaching Chinese to Speakers of Other Languages, all other majors require a score of at least level 4 or above in the Chinese Proficiency Test (HSK). Students who have completed their secondary school studies in Chinese can apply for exemption from submitting this certificate. Students applying for all-English-taught programs have no such requirement. Students whose Chinese proficiency does not meet the standard can apply to our school for Chinese language study first.
